title: Dashboard parsimony: surgical cuts to card set, trace links, and per-route cost rollups
creator: Marina Lopez
description: PRD follow-up: Reduce the Console Observability MVP surface by surgically removing lower-impact dashboard cards, deferring full trace drill-ins, and consolidating cost breakdowns to per-route rollups. This ticket records the clarified requirements, trade-offs, and acceptance criteria for the trimmed shipping slice so eng, design, and infra share the same contract for launch. Goal: deliver a compact, actionable landing experience that meets latency and cost SLOs while cutting telemetry ingestion and UI rendering complexity.
acceptance_criteria: Landing dashboard ships with exactly 3 primary cards: Route throughput (TPS), 95th percentile latency (ms), and Per-route cost rollup (USD/1k tokens). No other cards rendered on MVP landing view.

Trace surface change: replace on-click full trace drill-in with a lightweight sample-summary modal (top span durations, error counts, trace id link placeholder). Full trace deep-dive is deferred to Post-MVP.
Cost breakdowns are aggregated to route-level only; token-level or model-level breakdowns are hidden behind a 'Detailed billing' deferred flag and not part of MVP.

Telemetry ingestion budget: reduce event types for MVP to metrics + sparse error traces; estimated 30% lower ingestion than original PRD. Infra confirms retention and storage budget aligns with runtime-1.18 constraints.

Rollout gating: feature launches to 10% of orgs behind a configuration flag with telemetry to validate no regressions in Console latency (median page load < 600ms) and backend p99 < 800ms under sample traffic.
Design signoff completed on compact cards and sample-summary modal; accessible color contrast and responsive behavior validated for desktop and tablet breakpoints.

Smoke tests: end-to-end smoke verifies card data correctness for synthetic routes, cost numbers match billing sampling dashboard within 2% discrepancy, and sample-summary modal opens within 250ms of click.
Documentation: one-page product notes describing what was removed, where to find deferred features, and migration path for enterprise customers are published in Confluence link below.
decisions: Defer full trace drill-ins to Post-MVP: trade-off accepted to reduce backend indexing and UI complexity. Engineering to expose a trace-id placeholder for future linking.

Consolidate cost breakdown: show aggregated per-route rollup only. Rationale: highest immediate customer signal for cost/latency trade-offs; detailed billing deferred to a separate billing remediation track.

Reduce telemetry types for MVP to metrics + sparse error traces: lowers cost and speeds up release but reduces fidelity for some regression scenarios. Acceptable for initial launch with monitoring guardrails.
Cap landing cards at three to focus user attention and reduce rendering complexity; additional cards will be introduced behind feature flags in later cycles.
